svg.title: PTSD and substance use often occur together
svg.desc: About 45 percent of people who have had PTSD at some point in their lives also meet the criteria for an alcohol or other substance use disorder. Integrated treatment that addresses both conditions together, without requiring abstinence first, shows the greatest benefit compared with treatment as usual.
svg.text: PTSD and substance use often occur together
And treating both at the same time works better than treating either alone

g.text: More medical, legal, financial, and social challenges
Integrated treatment that addresses trauma and
substance use together shows the greatest benefit

svg.text: Norman, Hicks, Klein & Hamblen, 2025 — PTSD: National Center for PTSD, U.S. Dept. of Veterans Affairs
